def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    orders = db['orders']
    order_items = db['order_items']
    reviews = db['reviews']
    payments = db['payments']

    seed_time = pd.Timestamp(seed_time)

    # --- Фильтруем каждую таблицу только по информации, доступной на seed_time ---
    # Заказы: учитываем только уже совершённые покупки
    orders_hist = orders[orders['order_purchase_timestamp'] <= seed_time]

    # Позиции: используем ts (момент покупки заказа позиции)
    items = order_items[order_items['ts'] <= seed_time]
    items = items[items['product_id'].isin(entity_ids)]

    # Объединяем с заказами (все они уже в прошлом)
    merged = items.merge(
        orders_hist[['order_id', 'customer_id', 'order_purchase_timestamp',
                     'order_delivered_customer_date']],
        on='order_id',
        how='left'
    )

    # Отзывы: учитываем только те, что уже написаны (review_creation_date <= seed_time)
    reviews_hist = reviews[reviews['review_creation_date'] <= seed_time]

    # Платежи: только те, что уже существуют (ts <= seed_time)
    payments_hist = payments[payments['ts'] <= seed_time]

    # --- Признаки по продажам ---
    features = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name='product_id'))

    merged['days_since_purchase'] = (seed_time - merged['order_purchase_timestamp']).dt.days

    g = merged.groupby('product_id')

    features['num_orders'] = g['order_id'].nunique()
    features['num_items'] = g.size()
    features['total_price'] = g['price'].sum()
    features['total_freight'] = g['freight_value'].sum()
    features['avg_price'] = g['price'].mean()
    features['max_price'] = g['price'].max()
    features['num_customers'] = g['customer_id'].nunique()
    features['num_sellers'] = g['seller_id'].nunique()

    # Давность покупок
    features['days_since_last_order'] = g['days_since_purchase'].min()
    features['days_since_first_order'] = g['days_since_purchase'].max()
    features['avg_days_since'] = g['days_since_purchase'].mean()

    # Продажи за последние окна
    for window in [30, 60, 90]:
        recent = merged[merged['days_since_purchase'] <= window]
        rg = recent.groupby('product_id')
        features[f'num_orders_{window}d'] = rg['order_id'].nunique()
        features[f'total_price_{window}d'] = rg['price'].sum()

    # Тренд: продажи последних 30 дней vs предыдущих 30
    recent30 = merged[merged['days_since_purchase'] <= 30].groupby('product_id')['order_id'].nunique()
    prev30 = merged[(merged['days_since_purchase'] > 30) & (merged['days_since_purchase'] <= 60)].groupby('product_id')['order_id'].nunique()
    features['orders_ratio_30_60'] = recent30 / (prev30 + 1)

    # Время доставки (только по уже доставленным заказам)
    delivered = merged.dropna(subset=['order_delivered_customer_date'])
    delivery_time = (delivered['order_delivered_customer_date'] - delivered['order_purchase_timestamp']).dt.days
    delivered = delivered.assign(delivery_time=delivery_time)
    features['avg_delivery_days'] = delivered.groupby('product_id')['delivery_time'].mean()

    # --- Отзывы (только уже созданные) ---
    prod_orders = merged[['product_id', 'order_id']].drop_duplicates()
    merged_rev = prod_orders.merge(
        reviews_hist[['order_id', 'review_score']],
        on='order_id',
        how='left'
    )
    rgrp = merged_rev.groupby('product_id')['review_score']
    features['avg_review_score'] = rgrp.mean()
    features['num_reviews'] = rgrp.count()
    features['bad_review_ratio'] = (merged_rev.assign(is_bad=(merged_rev['review_score'] <= 2).astype(int))
                                    .groupby('product_id')['is_bad'].mean())

    # --- Платежи (только уже существующие) ---
    merged_pay = prod_orders.merge(
        payments_hist[['order_id', 'payment_type', 'payment_installments', 'payment_value']],
        on='order_id',
        how='left'
    )
    pgrp = merged_pay.groupby('product_id')['payment_value']
    features['avg_payment_value'] = pgrp.mean()
    features['total_payment_sum'] = pgrp.sum()
    features['payment_transactions_count'] = pgrp.count()
    features['avg_payment_installments'] = merged_pay.groupby('product_id')['payment_installments'].mean()
    credit_ratio = (merged_pay.assign(is_credit=(merged_pay['payment_type'] == 'credit_card').astype(int))
                    .groupby('product_id')['is_credit'].mean())
    features['credit_card_ratio'] = credit_ratio

    # --- Индикатор наличия продаж ---
    features['has_sales'] = (features['num_orders'] > 0).astype(int)

    # Числовые признаки, заполнение пропусков
    features = features.fillna(0)

    # Реиндексация под entity_ids
    features = features.reindex(entity_ids)

    return features
